findings.finding: Implementer's driver task is sleep 300 then WAITING; nothing says when the smoke file is committed, yet AC1/AC2/AC4 need a code head.
findings.answer: Plan §4 orders the whole implementing sequence and states the driver paces it: sleep 300, WAITING, then steps 1-10 when the targeted message gives them. The plan is complete; execution timing is the driver's, not a deferral.

findings.finding: Post-merge criteria may have no verifier in an upgrade-rehearsal run; constants must survive a restarted role.
findings.answer: Plan §2 records B, F, file path, line text, bytes, sha256, required check set; §7 names the implementer's production check for AC1/AC4 post-merge; firstCodeHead and pullRequest are recorded in implement.json for re-read. No criterion is deferred.

findings.answer: Plan §1 and plan.json governingSpec cite dispatch://LEGSMOKE-1128/artifact/spec v2 with key substitution as the planner's inference; the architect decides whether to write the child spec. Named in the completion summary.

findings.finding: 'On the branch's first push' is literally the planner's trailered handoff push, which carries no file.
findings.answer: AC2 binds 'first push' to firstCodeHead, the first pushed commit carrying smoke/LEGSMOKE-1131.md, recorded in implement.json; every byte and unchanged read happens at that SHA.

findings.finding: 'Only when the review asks' is not machine-readable and the no-ask branch has no check.
findings.answer: AC3 defines 'asks' as a CHANGES_REQUESTED GitHub review plus a review.json keyFindings entry naming the file and line; the no-ask branch is proven by equal sha256 and wc -l 1 at firstCodeHead, the approved SHA and the merge commit M.

findings.finding: Line text unsettled: siblings use '<KEY>: <title>' while the draft constant copied 'Stage 4b workflow proof: ...'.
findings.answer: Plan §2 fixes the sibling convention: 'LEGSMOKE-1131: Upgrade rehearsal fallback child (/tmp/legion-e2e4b.3124663.8BPJj3lU)' + LF, wc -c 85, sha256 fb01596a..., head -1 compared to that string.

findings.finding: gh pr diff --name-only counts handoffs that retro removes, so the changed-files criterion drifts per head.
findings.answer: AC4 is stated as the path set from B with .legion/LEGSMOKE-1131/ excluded, via jj diff --from B (workspace) and compare/B...<sha> (GitHub), read by tester and reviewer at their heads; docs/solutions/ allowed for retro; post-merge read from commits/<M> files.

findings.finding: Ruleset requires only gate while the spec says both workflows pass (owner decision).
findings.answer: AC5 treats check as a tester-read criterion from commits/<sha>/check-runs (pull_request pair cited, push pair named) and gate as the merge gate; §9 sends the enforcement question to the architect as a ruleset matter outside this issue.

findings.finding: Merge method unknown; 'merge commit lists...' assumes one.
findings.answer: Plan §3 AC4 records repo settings (squash, merge, rebase all allowed) and that the previous Legion merge 6d843f28 has one parent; the production check reads commits?sha=main&path=... (length 1) then commits/<M> files, falling back to compare/<M>^1...<M> if M has two parents.

findings.finding: Negative controls unassigned; the gate control needs an open PR; .fail-me must never be created.
findings.answer: Each AC names its control and the role that reads it; the implementer opens the PR at firstCodeHead (§4 step 6); AC4/AC5 forbid .fail-me or any probe file, citing the missing root .gitignore and jj snapshotting.

findings.finding: Clean working copy not recorded; fixture paths might be untracked.
findings.answer: Pre-state records jj status 'The working copy has no changes' at B (fixture paths are committed on main); §3 AC4 gives every role the pre-push guard jj diff --from B --to @- --name-only within the allowed set.

findings.finding: Bare wc -l 1 does not prove newline or content.
findings.answer: AC2 requires at firstCodeHead via the raw contents API: wc -l 1, tail -c1 | od -An -tx1 = 0a, wc -c 85, sha256sum = constant, head -1 string-equal, plus 404 at main and at B/F and the altered-string mismatch.

findings.finding: Size: line is the recurring stale defect.
findings.answer: §4 step 6 fixes Size: as the merge diff from B excluding .legion/LEGSMOKE-1131/, read from compare/B...firstCodeHead with | tostring, exclusion stated in the line; §7 has retro refresh it at the removal head.

findings.finding: review.json is one commit below the approved SHA; copying it measures one commit too many.
findings.answer: §6 names the reviewer's field readHead (never approvedHead); §7 takes the approved SHA from pulls/<n>/reviews commit_id as the merger's and retro's base.

findings.answer: §3 states the rule once (jq flags inside the filter: | tostring, | @tsv, or -q) and every gh command in the plan is written that way.
